component.name: Roxora Imager
component.summary: Write Roxora images to SD cards, USB drives and board storage

description.p: Roxora Imager writes Roxora images, Ubuntu with Armbian kernels for single-board computers, to SD cards and USB drives, and to a board's eMMC or SPI NOR flash over USB in Maskrom mode.
It downloads images from the Roxora releases on GitHub, checks them against the release checksums, and reads every write back to compare it with the release.
Writing no longer stops with a "file closed" error after the data is written, before the drive is read back.
Writing an SD card or USB drive works again: the step that asks for administrator rights failed at once on every system.
